title: Philo-Photo International Photography Contest 2026
description: Submit up to three original photographs exploring Recurring Patterns in Life. Open to photographers worldwide aged 18 and above.
descriptionDetailed: Philo-Photo is an annual contest where philosophy meets photography, organized by New Acropolis. The 2026 theme is Recurring Patterns in Life (Nature and Humanity). Photographers may enter up to three images taken with a camera or smartphone; generative AI and Photoshop-created images are not accepted. Three cash prizes totaling $1,700 are awarded.

entry.feeNote: $22 for one photo, $38 for two, $45 for three

prize.description: Grand Prize $1,000 for the overall winner, $500 for second place, and $200 for third place. Winners also receive certificates, an online gallery showcase, and honorary titles including Photographer of the Year.

audience.eligibilityLabel: Open to photographers worldwide aged 18 and above
audience.eligibilityDetail: Amateur and professional photographers worldwide are eligible. Entries must be original photographs taken with a camera or smartphone; generative AI, Photoshop-created, or watermarked images are not accepted. Each photographer may submit up to three single images on the annual theme.
